question: What primary disciplines are combined within the field of nursing informatics?

options.B: Public health, statistics, and hardware maintenance
options.C: Nursing science, computer science, and information science

explanation: Nursing informatics merges nursing principles with computer and information sciences to manage healthcare data effectively. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h1)

question: How do software applications directly improve daily bedside nursing care?

options.A: By replacing the need for physical clinical assessments entirely
options.B: By reducing documentation errors and organizing patient data
options.C: By eliminating verbal communication among the medical team
options.D: By speeding up the hospital billing and revenue collection process

explanation: Digital tools help organize vital signs and history, minimizing mistakes common in paper charting. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h1)

question: Which Microsoft Word feature is best suited for organizing a shift duty roster?
explanation: Tables arrange text into rows and columns, making schedules and rosters easy to read at a glance. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h2)

question: A nurse is drafting a formal hospital policy on hand hygiene. Why use Microsoft Word templates?

options.A: Templates automatically calculate patient medication dosages
options.B: Templates convert plain text into a secure electronic health record
options.C: Templates help standardize the document format across the institution
options.D: Templates prevent unauthorized staff from editing the file

explanation: Pre-designed templates maintain a consistent professional layout for official hospital documents. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h2)

question: What is the primary function of Microsoft Excel in a healthcare setting?

options.A: Drafting narrative patient care plans and referral letters
options.B: Sending encrypted email messages between hospital departments
options.C: Designing multimedia slide shows for public health lectures
options.D: Organizing and analyzing numerical data in spreadsheets

explanation: Excel specializes in handling numbers, calculations, and structured data tables. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h3)

question: Why would a nurse manager use an Excel chart to present monthly ward infection rates?

options.A: Visual graphs make performance trends easier for the team to grasp
options.B: Graphs are required by law for all nursing administrative reports
options.C: Charts automatically lock the spreadsheet to prevent data tampering
options.D: Visual tools eliminate the need to collect raw numerical data

explanation: Converting numbers into visual charts helps stakeholders quickly identify patterns or problem areas. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h3)

question: What is a primary use of Microsoft PowerPoint in professional nursing practice?

options.A: Managing complex patient billing and insurance claims
options.B: Calculating statistical averages for hospital mortality rates
options.C: Writing detailed, paragraph-heavy clinical progress notes
options.D: Creating visual slide presentations for training and education

explanation: PowerPoint is designed for building slide shows used in teaching, conferences, and seminars. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h4)

question: A community health nurse is preparing a talk on malaria prevention for local villagers. Which slide design principle should be prioritized?

options.A: Writing out the complete lecture speech word-for-word on every slide
options.B: Applying rapid flashing animations to keep the audience awake
options.C: Including complex statistical formulas from recent research journals
options.D: Using simple bullet points and clear images rather than dense text

explanation: Community education materials must be visually clear and easy to read without overwhelming the audience. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h4)

question: Why must nurses never share their electronic health record login passwords?

options.A: To comply with software licensing rules set by Microsoft
options.B: To ensure the computer system runs at a faster processing speed
options.C: To prevent the hospital management from tracking work hours
options.D: To protect patient confidentiality and prevent unauthorized record access

explanation: Sharing passwords compromises patient privacy and holds the account owner accountable for unauthorized entries. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h5)

question: What ethical violation occurs when a nurse posts a patient's wound photo on a personal social media account?

options.A: Violation of hospital inventory management policies
options.B: Failure to perform proper wound care documentation
options.C: Inaccurate use of Microsoft Word formatting tools
options.D: Breach of patient privacy and confidentiality

explanation: Sharing identifiable patient media without explicit consent violates fundamental nursing ethics and privacy laws. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h5)
